title: 업무 드라이브(데몬 자동 업로드·분류·부서 접근, 파일 전용) 계약

crossYearFixture.description: 업무 드라이브는 ERP 원장을 읽거나 쓰지 않는다. 저장소는 data/drive 의 파일과 index.jsonl 뿐이며 MSSQL 연결을 열지 않는다. 파일명의 차수는 표시·분류용 문자열이고 OrderYear/OrderWeek 키를 만들지 않는다.

dnspyEvidence.source: nenova.exe 기능이 아닌 웹 전용 화면. ERP 테이블 side effect 는 모두 preserve.
methods: Shared drive storage allows up to 100 GiB, bounded by indexed usage plus filesystem available bytes above a 5 GiB operating reserve; new writes are refused when free space cannot be measured. Admin usage reports available bytes; 507 rejects files above the effective limit.
Invoice PDF ↔ result workbook pairing from data/drive/index.jsonl → data/drive/pairs.json (lib/workDrivePairs, admin-only GET /api/work/drive-pairs, no SQL)

Web direct uploads mirrored into data/drive via lib/workDrive.mirrorWebUpload (hostname 'web', eventType 'web-upload', source=feature path); never throws, upload API responses unchanged, no SQL (2026-11-09)

pairWorker: The authenticated ingest endpoint admits two concurrent bodies per web process and holds at most 24 additional connections for 15 seconds before Retry-After. A separate low-priority child stores the original and index; a bounded, recoverable on-disk intent precedes new invoice/result writes. Pair analysis runs in another supervised child and is no longer awaited by upload; its atomic output and admin recompute format are unchanged. Automatic jobs request an acknowledgment only, so the web process need not receive the full saved pair document. Worker processes receive no ERP credentials. Remit parsing runs in the child, legacy SQL import is awaited before 200 as before. Contended mirrors can spool locally; overload remains explicit.
ingestIndexCache: Ingest-only process cache holds duplicate/version/latest-size aggregates. Exact dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs signatures invalidate on external changes. Only own verified append updates aggregates without rereading; unsupported legacy rows fall back to historical scan. History and download paths still read the original complete audit index. Normal list ACL is applied per call to the separately validated read-only list snapshot. No SQL/remit changes.
listReader: Normal authenticated GET /api/work/drive reads one read-only audit snapshot in a supervised low-priority child with no credentials/user objects. A dev/ino/size/mtimeNs/ctimeNs signature caches only unchanged snapshots; up to two stable-read attempts, 64 MiB index cap, one child, at most 64 waiters, pending-batch coalescing and a 10-second monotonic queue-plus-work deadline; idle exit after 60 seconds. Calls arriving after dispatch require a later batch. Existing per-call ACL, alias normalization and sort stay in the web process. Default GET preserves successful JSON fields. The screen opts into format=table-v1, a lossless dictionary/column transport decoded to the identical files array including unknown fields. Bounded chunked serialization yields between chunks and respects backpressure/disconnect. Every request revalidates the exact index signature before reusing unchanged raw rows across IPC; no authorization result is shared between users. Admin usage uses the same audit snapshot and a fresh complete disk scan (no usage TTL); quota/correction/download paths unchanged. Busy/read/launch/IPC/timeout failures return 503 with Retry-After and never publish stale authorization data. The read path creates no data/drive files.
